observation_contract.fixed_initial_fields: all seven first snapshots given exactly and identically to both methods; raw coordinates retained
observation_contract.initial_loads: same declared sensor law as other loads, not made fixed
observation_contract.variance: known sensor law; observation-only plug-in used only for first-order covariance diagnostics; no clean truth used in inverse weights

observation_contract.domain_failure_rule: retain and stop that case; no redraw or repair

data.generator: independent continuous finite-volume BDF; no inverse assembler or manufactured compensating forcing

shared_prior.physical_signs: nonnegative source/storage/transport/boundary scales; heat capacity contrast [0,2]
shared_prior.parameter_bounds: parameter_box(candidate) fixed in source; no truth-centered initializations

budgets.interpretation: equal CPU ceilings, not convergence guarantee; all truncation/failures retained; no best-epoch Adam or profile refinement

selection.identity: heuristic common complexity score, not calibrated BIC under the actual sensor law
selection.candidate_failures: remain in denominator; no selected estimate if all fail

precision.material_transport_boundary_combinations: all errors and local inactive directions reported separately; not silently declared precisely recovered

adoption_gate.positive_same_fit_source_structure_and_p: at least 10/12 positive role-noise blocks (shared/free/independent/oxygen/steam/wrong-heat); independent role not converted to shared truth
adoption_gate.source_component_gain: both of the 2 same-observation true-shared pairs have assessable shared/free reaction scores; shared <= 0.8 * free and shared precise; failures nonwins
adoption_gate.matched_external: both complete programs receive identical inputs and priors; WPHID positive precision count not lower, assessable selected score median ratio <=1.1; a bounded descriptive gate, not formal noninferiority or native best-tuned ADAM advantage
adoption_gate.stop: evaluate once, retain failure; no additional data, weights, restarts, noise draws, candidates or changed precision thresholds

confirmation_if_adopted.independent_control: same frozen programs/candidates on new 660s natural trajectories, 1 new noise block per role, seed root 202610130900; fixed material point; does not prove continuum coverage
confirmation_if_adopted.engineering: read-only old four saved R100 arrays as engineering compatibility challenge, explicitly already viewed and not independent experimental confirmation
confirmation_if_adopted.gate_rule: if development adoption fails, both phases recorded as not run by dependency; no wasted confirmation
